name: What is the process for planning a garage interior upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning a garage interior upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for planning a garage interior upgrade typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. This is followed by a site visit to assess the existing space and take measurements. Our team then develops a design proposal, including material selections and a detailed cost estimate. Once approved, we schedule the work, managing all aspects from demolition (if needed) to installation and finishing touches. Throughout the project, we ensure clear communication and adherence to timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Planning a garage interior upgrade involves an initial consultation, site assessment, design proposal with cost estimates, and then project scheduling and execution.
